messages:
Noah (AE): Symphony Capital wants a 3-day POC. Requirements: Private/VPC connectivity, perimeter TLS inspection, single allowlist egress IP for their firewall. Need: short firewall snippet, can PrivateLink work with their DPI, and ballpark POC pricing. @Iris @Vik @Lena

Iris (Solutions): PrivateLink is fine but note our backend egresses from Redwood IPs. If their DPI terminates TLS, mutual-TLS or cert-based auth can break. Recommend two options: (1) PrivateLink only + ask customer to preserve TLS passthrough; (2) deploy a small connector VM in their VPC so inspection happens locally before traffic leaves. Connector preserves client src IPs.

Vik (NetOps): Pasteable fw snippet: ``# Symphony POC allowlist
# replace <REDFW_EGRESS> and <PRIV_ENI_CIDR>
ALLOW tcp from <app_subnets> to <PRIV_ENI_CIDR> port 443
ALLOW tcp from <connector_subnets> to <REDFW_EGRESS> ports 443
ALLOW udp from <connector_subnets> to 8.8.8.8 port 53``

Vik (NetOps): Static egress: we can provide one /32 for the POC (HA pair recommended for prod).

Lena (Security): 2-line blurb for their packet: "Redwood will deploy an interface endpoint into customer-managed subnets for the POC. Outbound requests will egress from Redwood-managed static IP(s) provided; if Symphony performs TLS inspection that terminates TLS, Redwood recommends deploying a connector in the VPC or providing a cert re-issue flow to preserve mutual authentication and audit logs."

Iris (Solutions): Pricing sketch for packet: static egress IP (POC) = $1,500/month (pro-rated), connector VM = $450/month + $1,000 one-time. Dedicated reserved capacity available if they need more IPs or throughput; quote on request.

Noah (AE): Action items: Iris to confirm IP list + quote by EOD Mon, Vik to attach a one-page topology sketch, Lena to update the security packet. deploy-bot: ticket POC-2246 created.

Iris (Solutions): Acknowledged, will follow up.
